newsitem.title: USA: Group seeks to remove Petrolite board.
newsitem.headline: Group seeks to remove Petrolite board.

text.p: A group including Boatmen's Bancshares Inc and Barnickel Co said on Tuesday that it called for the removal of Petrolite Corp's board.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said Barnickel Co intends to solicit written comments from the holders of shares of Capital Stock to remove all the members of the board of directors of the company.
But in the filing, it suggested retaining Andrew Craig, Louis Fernandez, William Maritz, Fairfax Pollnow and Wayne Grace.

Barnickel also recommended electing Robert Kresko, John Peters MacCarthy, Robert Quenon, John Sexton and V. Raymond Stranghoener. Barnickel said these actions are designed to maximize stockholder value by electing directors who intend to analyze the financial and operating status of the company.
Barnickel also said the new board could pursue a "process for the sale or merger of the company on the most advantageous terms for all stockholders."
The group holds a 49.30 percent stake in Petrolite, or 5,590,778 common shares, according to the latest filing.
On November 12, Barnickel filed preliminary consent solicitation materials with the SEC.

While Barnickel claims high regard for the current board, it said the reason for the filing is "an honest difference of opinion as to whether the projections underlying management's business plan are realistically achievable."
Barnickel firmly believes that the projections are not realistically achievable and that this is an opportune time to seek the sale of the company.
Also on November 12, Barnickel filed a complaint with the Delaware Court of Chancery against the company and five board members, the filing said.
The complaint challenges provisions of Petrolite's shareholder rights agreement that would block Barnickel's move to solicit proxies supporting its plan to remove the directors.
The complaint seeks a summary judgment or a temporary restraining order against Petrolite.
